scope: Eight new starter-kit input/control boards; no existing component IDs or geometry modified.

validation.sourceReview: Manufacturer photos compared with same-side wiring diagrams; contact labels, order and functions reviewed. Grove J1 signals also checked against the manufacturer Eagle board XML and schematic.
validation.standalone: Family imports and registry validation pass. Both SVG modes render. Every contact has a physical anchor and matching illustrated metal contact. Footprint terminal map contains all 29 contacts exactly once.
validation.nativeKiCad: Pending registration by integrating agent; format acceptance does not establish geometry accuracy.

entries.physicalView: Component side with control above and male-header mating tips below. Pins numbered left to right for this catalog; source boards print signal labels rather than numeric pin IDs.
entries.footprintEvidence: Reference 2.54 mm cable/header carrier. Header order follows the maker's component-side wiring view; board outline, connector offset and control clearance are approximate. This is not a production module land pattern. Generated 3D geometry is approximate.
limitations: The 2.54 mm host header carrier is representative. Native PCB dimensions, connector offsets and control clearances were not verified from a mechanical drawing.

references.kind: manufacturer Eagle CAD, downloaded and parsed

entries.physicalView: Component-side module overview plus one enlarged J1 mating face, PCB below face. Hidden top-view connector contacts are not replaced by exposed solder tails. Inset pin1 left through pin4 right follows Eagle connector geometry.
entries.footprintEvidence: Off-board Grove cable termination carrier, 2.00 mm pitch. Pad numbers and electrical functions are verified against the maker's Eagle J1 netlist and schematic. This reference carrier is not the module PCB, a socket production footprint or a verified host-board mating land pattern. Generated 3D geometry is approximate.
limitations: The host carrier uses a four-pad 2.00 mm cable termination and does not reproduce the native module PCB or qualify a production connector footprint.
Grove pin2 is a separately driven LED input through a 1 kΩ resistor to an LED returning to ground, not NC. Native Eagle contact references: J1.1→OUT/R1.2; J1.2→LED/R2.1; J1.3→VCC/R1.3; J1.4→GND/R1.1.
Generated WRL consists of approximate boxes, independent of any external vendor CAD link.
